Inspects and enforces system-wide I/O resource hygiene across .zqk directories.

Measures open file descriptors against process limits, inspects storage volume

breakdown, sweeps stale lock files without active holders, reaps abandoned

temporary files (*.tmp, *.tmp-*, .tmp-*), and enforces retention policies on
logs.

  Inspect and enforce all hygiene rules
  zqk system resource-hygiene
  Dry-run scan without deleting files
  zqk system resource-hygiene --dry-run
  Reap only orphaned temporary files older than 1 hour
  zqk system resource-hygiene --reap-locks=false --enforce-retention=false --temp-threshold 1h
  Prune logs older than 3 days
  zqk system resource-hygiene --log-max-age 3d
  JSON output for automation and telemetry integration
  zqk system resource-hygiene --format json

Usage:
  zqk system resource-hygiene [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Scan and report hygiene issues without modifying or deleting files
      --enforce-retention       Prune or truncate logs older than max-age or larger than max-size (default true)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --lock-threshold string   Threshold duration for stale locks (e.g. 15m, 1h) (default "15m")
      --log-max-age string      Threshold duration for log retention (e.g. 24h, 3d, 7d) (default "7d")
      --log-max-size string     Maximum log file size before truncation (e.g. 5MB, 10MB) (default "10MB")
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
      --project-root string     Project root directory
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --reap-locks              Reap stale .lock files whose holding processes are dead (default true)
      --reap-temp               Reap orphaned temporary files older than the threshold (default true)
      --temp-threshold string   Threshold duration for orphaned temp files (e.g. 30m, 2h) (default "30m")
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
